issues.description: One PR doing four unrelated things — should have been at least three patches
issues.detail: This bundles the Risk Radar feature, a global 'Threat Score' to 'Prowler ThreatScore' rename across unrelated files, a Findings page category filter, a horizontal-bar-chart math refactor, and a SEVERITY_ORDER alias. When the bar-chart percentage regression lands in six months, the bisect points to 'feat(ui): Risk Radar'. Split: radar feature, rename, findings filter, bar-chart fix.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER gets a duplicate 'Info' key aliased to 'Informational' with zero explanation
issues.detail: Adding `Info: 4` alongside `Informational: 4` in a shared constants file is the exact kind of silent dual-vocabulary that bites maintainers later. Either the API returns both spellings — in which case normalize at the boundary — or it doesn't, and this line is dead. No commit message, no test, no comment. Pick one name.

issues.description: SPECIAL_CASES dictionary ships empty — speculative abstraction with no second example
issues.detail: `SPECIAL_CASES` is an empty Record with a comment saying 'add entries here if needed.' That's the speculative-fourth-driver pattern. Delete it. When a real special case shows up, add the dictionary then, shaped by an actual example instead of a guess. Code earns abstraction by being duplicated in anger.

issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristics changed silently — old explicit map deleted, no tests shown
issues.detail: The previous adapter had an explicit CATEGORY_LABELS map ('Trust Boundaries', 'Forensics Ready'). The replacement is heuristic: short-word=acronym, regex for version suffix, default capitalize. 'trustboundaries' now renders as 'Trustboundaries' instead of 'Trust Boundaries' — a visible regression. Either restore the explicit map or land a unit test table covering every known category ID.

issues.description: Horizontal bar chart recomputes maxValue inside the render loop per item
issues.detail: `Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.value))` runs once per item inside `.map()`. O(n²) on what should be O(n). Hoist it above the loop. Not a correctness bug, but it's the kind of thing the next maintainer reads and wonders why.

issues.description: Active filter badge for 'category__in' was deleted, not moved — likely a regression
issues.detail: DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES loses its category entry while the PR adds a category filter to the findings page. If the badge system is what renders the 'X Categories filtered' chip, removing it while adding the filter means active category filters no longer show a badge. Confirm this is intentional or restore the entry.

review.summary: This is a feature patch wearing the clothes of one PR but doing the work of three or four. The Risk Radar component itself is fine — small, scoped, readable — but it arrived stapled to a global 'Threat Score' rename, a findings-page filter addition, a bar-chart math refactor, and a quiet replacement of an explicit label map with heuristics. The heuristic replacement deletes 'Trust Boundaries' as a known good label and replaces it with whatever 'trustboundaries' capitalizes to, with no test table to catch the regression. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Split the patches, restore the explicit label map (or add a test table), drop the empty SPECIAL_CASES dictionary, and justify the SEVERITY_ORDER Info/Informational duplication.
